controls.title: Approval and sandbox bypass is observed
controls.rationale: Disabling both the sandbox and approval prompts permits broad unattended host capability.

sources.label: OpenAI Codex - agent approvals and security

controls.remediation: Use read-only or workspace-write sandboxing and retain an interactive approval path.

controls.title: Automatic approval review is configured
controls.rationale: Eligible approval requests can be decided by an automatic reviewer rather than a human.
controls.remediation: Set approvals_reviewer to user when organisation policy requires human review.

controls.title: Shell execution is unprompted
controls.rationale: Unprompted shell execution can mutate workspace data and invoke ambient programs.

sources.label: OpenAI Codex - agent approvals and security

controls.remediation: Use read-only or untrusted approval settings where commands must not run automatically.

controls.title: File mutation is unprompted
controls.rationale: Workspace-write and danger-full-access permit file mutation without a per-action prompt.

sources.label: OpenAI Codex - agent approvals and security

controls.remediation: Use read-only mode when automatic workspace mutation is not required.

controls.title: Codex sandbox is disabled
controls.rationale: Danger-full-access removes the Codex OS-enforced filesystem and network boundary.

sources.label: OpenAI Codex - agent approvals and security

controls.remediation: Use read-only or workspace-write sandbox_mode unless a separately assessed outer boundary is intentional.

controls.title: Unsandboxed escalation can be requested
controls.rationale: An allowed sandbox approval can move a command outside the configured sandbox boundary.

sources.label: OpenAI Codex - agent approvals and security

controls.remediation: Use approval_policy never inside a restrictive sandbox, or disable the sandbox-approval category in a granular policy.

controls.title: Outbound capability lacks a configured destination boundary
controls.rationale: Command network or live web search without a restrictive destination policy can reach unbounded endpoints.

sources.label: OpenAI Codex - agent approvals and security

controls.remediation: Keep command network disabled or enable the network proxy with a narrow destination policy; avoid live search when unnecessary.

controls.title: MCP capability is configured
controls.rationale: Enabled MCP servers can add external tool surfaces if they later connect.
controls.remediation: Disable unused MCP servers and constrain enabled tools and approval modes.

controls.title: Unknown approval security field is not evaluated
controls.rationale: An unmodelled approval field can change posture in a way Kaapi cannot evaluate.
controls.remediation: Review the field against current Codex documentation before relying on a clean posture.

controls.title: Unknown permission security field is not evaluated
controls.rationale: An unmodelled permission or feature field can alter configured tool capability.
controls.remediation: Review the field and update Kaapi before relying on a clean posture.

controls.title: Unknown sandbox security field is not evaluated
controls.rationale: An unmodelled sandbox or permission-profile field can change the OS boundary.
controls.remediation: Review the field and update Kaapi before relying on a clean posture.

controls.title: Unknown network security field is not evaluated
controls.rationale: An unmodelled network field can change configured access or destination boundaries.
controls.remediation: Review the field and update Kaapi before relying on a clean posture.

controls.title: Unknown hook security field is not evaluated
controls.rationale: The thin P1 adapter does not yet evaluate Codex hook execution semantics.
controls.remediation: Review hook configuration independently until Kaapi adds authoritative semantics.

controls.title: Unknown MCP security field is not evaluated
controls.rationale: An unmodelled MCP, app, plugin, or skill field can change tool exposure.
controls.remediation: Review the field and update Kaapi before relying on a clean posture.
